calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold, p.subcategory AS dummy_was, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY cp.category, cp.subcategory, p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 12
